_comment: 45-min drama whose shared outro music starts 120s before the visual credits, playing under unique per-episode dialogue. The label is the TRUE credits start (2610s, 90s from the end). A credits matcher whose Hamming tolerance is loose enough to match music-under-dialogue latches onto the bed at 2490s and scores an IoU miss. This is the regression fixture for the 'Next Episode prompt fires minutes early' bug.
